name: Bokura no Himitsu Kichi Daisakusen ~Escape Hitonatsu no Omoide~
original_name: ボクらのヒミツ基地大作戦 ～エスケープ ひとなつのおもいで～
source:
Four girls, three boys, one abandoned building, no clothing!

After Satoshi and his friends sneak into an old abandoned building outside of town they meet Chikako, an older girl who lives there. She convinces them to abandon their clothing and morals and have sex day and night. But when the adults in their lives come to take them back will they be able to defend their secret base?
translation:
四个女孩，三个男孩，一栋废弃的建筑，没有衣服！

小智和他的朋友们潜入城外一栋废弃的旧建筑后，他们遇到了住在那里的年长女孩千花子。她说服他们放弃衣服和道德，日夜发生性行为。但当他们生命中的大人来接他们回去时，他们还能保卫自己的秘密基地吗？
